description: Main entry point for a Probot application handling GitHub repository events, issue creation, and comment updates, integrating with external components and a Flask backend.

methods.name: replyWithError
methods.description: Helper function to reply to an issue with an error message.

methods.name: getInitializationComment
methods.description: Generates the initial comment shown during repository setup.

methods.name: getRunningComment
methods.description: Generates the comment indicating setup is in progress.

methods.name: getCompletionComment
methods.description: Generates the completion message after setup is finished.
